_note: Our own mission hook templates (src/story/mission_hooks.gd). A briefing sets the goal and the stakes (Core p.40). 'sitreps' = which generated sitreps fit (data/game/gm/missions.json). Text fields are line lists; one variant is picked. {patron} = who asked, {target} / {place} / {cargo} are filled from the lists below and COMP/CON's name lists. success/failure effects use StoryEffects. 'board' = whether it shows on the hub's job board by itself (others only come from story events).

title: Convoy to {place}
Safe Passage
The Long Haul
Running the Road
objective: Get the convoy through {place}.
Escort {cargo} past {place} in one piece.
See the supply trucks safely through {place}.
stakes: If the convoy falls, {hub} goes hungry this season.
Lose the trucks and {patron} loses everything they've put into this.
The convoy carries medicine. People die if it doesn't arrive.

title: Hold {place}
Nobody Gets Through
Last Light at {place}
The Line
objective: Hold {place} until relief arrives.
Keep {enemy} off {place}.
Defend {place} for as long as it takes.
stakes: If {place} falls, {enemy} have a straight road into {hub}.
{patron} has promised the people here that the line will hold.
Lose it and the whole valley's water goes with it.

title: Hit the Depot
Burn the Stores
Supply Line Raid
Knock Out {place}
objective: Take the depot {enemy} hold at {place}.
Seize the supply caches {enemy} have stashed at {place}.
Break the grip {enemy} have on {place}.
stakes: Without those supplies, {enemy} can't keep up the pressure on {hub}.
{patron} wants this done before {enemy} can dig in.
If the raid fails, {enemy} will know exactly who sent you.

title: Lost and Found
Recovery Run
What Fell at {place}
Salvage Job
objective: Recover {cargo} from {place}.
Find the lost shipment of {cargo} near {place} and bring it back.
Get to the wreck at {place} before {enemy} strip it.
stakes: {patron} needs that cargo back, and no questions asked.
Whoever holds the cargo holds {hub}'s future.
If {enemy} get there first, they'll sell it to the highest bidder.

title: Clear the Road
Raider Problem
Quiet {place}
Pest Control
objective: Drive {enemy} away from {place}.
Break the {enemy} who've been hitting {place}.
Clear {place} of {enemy}.
stakes: Every week {enemy} stay, another farm empties.
{patron} is out of patience, and out of other options.
If they're not stopped, {enemy} will come for {hub} next.

title: Bring Them Home
Search and Rescue
Past the Perimeter
No One Left Behind
objective: Find the missing survey team near {place} and get them out.
Reach the people trapped at {place}.
Break through to {place} and bring the survivors back.
stakes: They won't last another night out there.
{patron} is begging. There's no one else to send.
If they die out there, {hub} will never trust Union pilots again.

title: Trouble Followed You
Unwanted Attention
Loose Ends
objective: Deal with the people who caught you snooping.
Shake off the {enemy} who followed you back from your digging.
stakes: They know your faces now.
If this isn't handled, nobody here will talk to you again.

title: Rightful Owners
Hot Merchandise
They Want It Back
objective: The owners of what you bought have come to collect. Stop them, or make it right.
stakes: Lose this and you lose the gear, and your name at the market.

title: Off-Plan
Bad Deal
Everything Goes Sideways
objective: Get out of the mess your last deal made, near {place}.
stakes: If this goes badly, the deal and everyone in it goes down with you.

title: Keeping the Lights On
Hostile Takeover
The Organization Needs You
objective: Your organization is in trouble. Defend its interests at {place}.
stakes: Fail, and the organization you built may not survive the season.

title: Paying Back {patron}
A Favor Owed
Calling It In
objective: {patron} has called in the favor you owe. They need {place} dealt with.
stakes: Do this and the debt is clear. Refuse, and {patron}'s people remember.
